summary: ```markdown # How to Download and Import Animation from Mixamo ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will cover the steps necessary to download animations from Mixamo and import them into Marvelous Designer. This process involves exporting and uploading a customized virtual model to Mixamo, downloading the T-Pose model, and then selecting and importing the desired animation. ## Step 1: Uploading Your Model to Mixamo To get started, we need to export and upload the customized virtual model to Mixamo. Ensure that your model is ready for export before proceeding. ## Step 2: Downloading the T-Pose Model Once the upload and binding process is complete, the next step is to download the model in T-Pose. The T-Pose serves as the base pose for your animations. ## Step 3: Selecting and Downloading the Animation After downloading the T-Pose model, you can now choose the animation you need. Make sure to select the appropriate settings for downloading the animation file to ensure compatibility. ## Step 4: Importing the FBX File into Marvelous Designer Once you have the animation file, import the FBX file into Marvelous Designer. To verify that the animation has been imported correctly, click the bottom triangle and check the key animation in the animation editor. ## Step 5: Organizing Imported Animations All videos are imported with specific options. After importing, you can choose the animation value of the imported animation, which will then appear in the Motion folder. ## Step 6: Creating a New Project Next, create a new project in Marvelous Designer. Import the T-Pose virtual model that you downloaded earlier, and then import the saved animation file. ## Step 7: Finalizing the Animation Setup When importing the animation, be sure to click to move to the beginning, and switch to the first motion. This action will allow the T-Pose to move to the beginning of the animation, which will automatically appear in your project. ## Conclusion Thank you for following this tutorial on downloading and importing animations from Mixamo into Marvelous Designer. These steps will help you integrate animations seamlessly into your projects. ```
